chapter: Spirits of Rhythm and the road in the 1930s
title: Playing the Howard Theater in Washington
summary: The Spirits played the colored Howard Theater in Washington and Bunn also played the Apollo.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: How about upstate, like did you go up to Buffalo or any of these places?
Where did you play in Washington, do you remember the clubs?
Yeah. Was there a big club there or something like that?
Yeah. We played at a theater.
There was a colored theater there. The Howard.
The Howard. Oh, yeah. The Howard. That's a big --
Like the Apollo, they've been there for years and years.
Yeah. The Howard has been -- I saw a big revue there about 1961.
It was great. Otis Redding and James Brown in the same show.
Uh-huh. Yeah, we played the Howard.
